why: Settled from the company's own 6-K filed 2026-09-02 (accession 0001193125-26-379443), exhibit 99.1: 'The Company will announce the Results on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 (Hong Kong time), before the trading hours of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange' with a call at 20:00 ET on 2026-09-15. Before HK open on 09-16 HKT is after the US close on 09-15 ET, so the US-tape event is 2026-09-15 amc, exactly as the calendar has it. The baseline's 27-day 'cadence' is an artefact — this very 6-K of 2026-09-02, recorded in the history as a print with a -0.48% reaction, is the scheduling announcement, not an earnings release.

why_history_untrustworthy: Confirmed directly rather than inferred: the eight 'prints' come from a 6-K results-language text match at a 27-day median gap, and the most recent one (2026-09-02, recorded with a -0.48% reaction) is the earnings-date scheduling announcement, while 2026-06-30 is the annual general meeting results announcement (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001269238/000119312526289388/d313478dex991.htm). None of the eight can be assumed to be an earnings release, so median_abs_move 1.78%, up_count 2/8 and the -12.55% 2026-06-25 outlier must not be used as an earnings base rate. The option-implied 6.54% is the only usable anchor on this name.
where_to_look: The Hong Kong line trades the print before the US does. 9961.HK gets a full session on 2026-09-16 HKT starting ~21:30 ET on 09-15, so by the US open on 09-16 the ADR reaction is largely an arbitrage off a price that already exists. Any hunter sizing this name should know its finding has to survive an overnight HK session, and the HKEX filing (same document, HKEXnews) is the earliest public copy.

The full interim report, not the release. As an FPI reporting a first half, Trip.com files an interim results announcement with segment and cash-flow detail that the earnings release headline omits — international/Trip.com brand take rate, sales-and-marketing as a share of revenue, and the equity-investment line that has swung net income before. HKEXnews carries it at the same moment as the 6-K.

The gap between this Q2 date and last year's. Q2 2025 was reported on 2025-09-01; this year's Q2 lands on 09-15, two weeks later, and the reason is not stated in the scheduling 6-K. Worth establishing whether that is calendar drift or something else before treating it as signal.

Buyback execution: the ADS count and any repurchases disclosed in the interim filing, against the authorisation. At $24.6bn with the stock 50% off its 52-week high this is the one capital-allocation lever the sell side underweights.
